description: This file defines the MenuAdapter class for an Android app, which manages the navigation menu items and their behaviors, including intents for help, trashbin, settings, and about activities, as well as generating specific intents for interacting with Nextcloud Files app.

classes.name: MenuAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class for a RecyclerView handling menu items, providing navigation functionality within the app.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Updates the color scheme of the menu items and refreshes the UI.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the stable ID for the item at a given position.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates new ViewHolder instances for RecyclerView.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for display.

methods.name: updateAccount
methods.description: Updates the intent associated with the trashbin menu item based on the provided account.

methods.name: generateTrashbinIntent
methods.description: Generates an intent to access the trashbin, choosing between app-specific and web-based intents based on version checks.

methods.name: generateTrashbinAppIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to launch the trashbin activity within the Nextcloud Files app if available.

methods.name: generateTrashbinWebIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to view the trashbin web URL for the specified account.
